rules.pass: The clock is synchronized, and chrony's offset (when it gives one) is under 100 ms.
rules.warn: The offset is 100 to 499 ms, or the clock is synchronized while the time service is switched off.
rules.fail: The clock is not synchronized, or the offset is 500 ms or more.
rules.unknown: Neither timedatectl, chrony nor the time-sync marker could be read.

advice.synchronized-offset: The clock is synchronized, {offset_ms} ms from network time.
advice.ntp-off: The clock is synchronized, but the time service is switched off, so it may drift. Start one (sudo systemctl enable --now chrony). More: https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#clock-sync
advice.offset: The clock is {offset_ms} ms from network time. Validators keep a 2,000 ms margin inside an 8 s slot, so a few hundred milliseconds matter. Check chrony's sources (chronyc sources). More: https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#clock-sync
advice.offset-large: The clock is {offset_ms} ms from network time, which is enough to miss slots. Fix the time service (chronyc sources, then chronyc makestep). More: https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#clock-sync
advice.not-synchronized: The clock is not synchronized. Install and start chrony (sudo apt install chrony). Validators need a synchronized clock to forge in time. More: https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#clock-sync

rules.pass: The median of (receipt time minus slot start) over at least 10 blocks in the window is between 0 and 2 s, allowing for up to 99 ms early.
rules.warn: The median is 100 to 499 ms early, or 2 s or more late.
rules.fail: The median is 500 ms or more early.
rules.unknown: Fewer than 10 blocks with a receipt line and a known slot, or a source could not be read.
rules.skipped: The relay does not run on this host.

advice.in-step: Blocks reach this relay a median {median_ms} ms after their slot begins (over {blocks} blocks).
advice.early: Blocks reach this relay a median {early_ms} ms before their slot begins by this host's clock, so this clock is at least {early_ms} ms behind. See clock.sync. More: https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#clock-vs-chain
advice.late: Blocks reach this relay a median {median_ms} ms after their slot begins by this host's clock: this clock may be ahead, or blocks arrive late. See clock.sync and peers.count. More: https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#clock-vs-chain
advice.too-few: Only {blocks} blocks in the window can be compared; {needed} are needed for a median. Try a longer --window.

rules.pass: No block was discarded for its slot, no late forging attempt was counted outside a forger's first slot, and no slot far from the clock was refused.
rules.warn: One or two such events in the window.
rules.fail: Three or more, or any refusal of a slot more than one away from the forger's clock.
rules.unknown: The log could not be read, or its level hides the lines needed.
rules.skipped: The role does not run on this host.

advice.clean: No sign of a wrong clock in the log.
advice.discarded: The relay discarded {count} blocks as coming from a future slot, or as received or processed too late. That usually means this clock is behind. See clock.sync. More: https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#clock-symptoms
advice.late: The forger failed {count} attempts because too little of the slot was left, or the next slot had begun. That usually means this clock is off, or the host is slow. See clock.sync. More: https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#clock-symptoms
advice.refused: A slot more than one away from this clock was refused {count} times. Fix the clock first: see clock.sync. More: https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#clock-symptoms
